The Flag on the Roof

Angles of elevation 30° and 45°, a 10 m building: find the flagstaff and the distance.

REC
0:00 / 2:00

How it's made. Every frame is drawn by JavaScript on one 1920×1080 canvas. The narration (synthesised offline), music and sound effects are one track embedded in this file. Captions follow the voice line by line, and CC hides them.

For YouTube. Export MP4 renders all frames at 60 fps, faster than real time, into an H.264 MP4 with the soundtrack (Chrome or Edge). Record .webm captures the canvas live at 60 fps while it plays; keep the tab visible while it records.

Real photo. The opening shows a real photograph of a building (building.jpg from the OpenCV sample images, Apache 2.0). The flagpole on its roof is drawn by code.
